after3_start.name: {name}
after3_start.text: *After school. My feet stop at the hallway junction. Signs for the student council room, the annex, and the gym point in different directions.*

after3_route_check.name: {name}
after3_route_check.text: *I check my phone. No reply, and the meeting time is just getting closer.*

after3_auto_dain.name: {name}
after3_auto_dain.text: *I have plans with Dain, so I head to the gym.*

after3_auto_yuna.name: {name}
after3_auto_yuna.text: *I have plans with Yuna, so I head to the library annex.*

after3_auto_seo.name: {name}
after3_auto_seo.text: *I have plans with Seoyeon, so I head to the student council room.*

after3_multi_choice.name: {name}
after3_multi_choice.text: *The plans overlap. Seoyeon's message, Dain's missed call, and Yuna's folded note are all on one screen. Who do I go to first?*

after3_reject_for_seo_1.name: {name}
after3_reject_for_seo_1.text: *I run into Dain in the hallway. Her usual energy is gone. The smile doesn't come first today.*

after3_reject_for_seo_2.name: Dain
after3_reject_for_seo_2.text: ...You're not coming to the gym today, are you?

after3_reject_for_seo_3.name: {name}
after3_reject_for_seo_3.text: *I pass by the library. Yuna's seat is empty. A single note remains in lavender ink. — 'I waited for two hours. I'm leaving first.'*

after3_reject_for_seo_3b.name: {name}
after3_reject_for_seo_3b.text: *Yuna's book is gone. Volume 1 that always sat there. Volume 2 she promised to lend me. And — the bookmark too. The old bookmark she kept so carefully.*

after3_reject_for_seo_3c.name: {name}
after3_reject_for_seo_3c.text: *No bookmark, no promised volume two. Only a long note Yuna left, folded on the desk.*

after3_reject_for_seo_4.name: {name}
after3_reject_for_seo_4.text: *I step into the hall. Dain's sentence ended quietly, and Yuna's seat was empty. The note in my hand crumples along its creases.*

after3_seo_1.name: {name}
after3_seo_1.text: *I open the student council room door. Seoyeon is slumped over her desk, and her clipboard lies on the floor.*

after3_seo_3.name: Seoyeon
after3_seo_3.text: *She lifts her head at the sound of someone entering. Her eyes look tired. Her makeup is slightly smudged.*

after3_seo_5_b.name: Seoyeon
after3_seo_5_b.text: *She hurriedly fixes her hair.* ...Did you see?

after3_seo_6.name: Seoyeon
after3_seo_6.text: *She clears her throat.* ...It's nothing. Forget it.

after3_seo_7.name: {name}
after3_seo_7.text: Forget what? I didn't see anything.

after3_seo_7_b.name: Seoyeon
after3_seo_7_b.text: *She looks down.* ...I really didn't want you to see this.

after3_seo_8.name: Seoyeon
after3_seo_8.text: This side of me. — Keep it a secret.

after3_seo_9.name: Seoyeon
after3_seo_9.text: *She straightens up. But — the smile doesn't come back.*

after3_seo_choice.name: Seoyeon
after3_seo_choice.text: Next time I ask you for a favor, you say yes. No questions. — Consider that the price.
choices: ...Just now? I didn't see anything. I dropped my pen and came in to pick it up.

after3_seo_pity_trap_1.name: Seoyeon
after3_seo_pity_trap_1.text: *She looks up and rubs at the makeup smear with the back of her hand.*

after3_seo_pity_trap_4.name: Seoyeon
after3_seo_pity_trap_4.text: *She wipes at the smudged makeup with the back of her hand, passing once beneath her eye and once across her mouth.*

after3_seo_pity_trap_5.name: Seoyeon
after3_seo_pity_trap_5.text: I didn't become student council president to be 'just anyone.'

after3_seo_pity_trap_6.name: Seoyeon
after3_seo_pity_trap_6.text: *She adjusts her glasses. The smudge remains on the back of her hand, and her voice drops lower.*

after3_seo_pity_trap_7.name: Seoyeon
after3_seo_pity_trap_7.text: Could you leave? I have work.

after3_seo_pity_trap_10.name: {name}
after3_seo_pity_trap_10.text: *I close the student council room door behind me. The hallway is empty. From inside comes the single sound of a clipboard being set on a desk.*

after3_seo_correct_1.name: Seoyeon
after3_seo_correct_1.text: *She freezes. In the silence, her grip tightens around the edge of the clipboard.*

after3_seo_correct_2.name: {name}
after3_seo_correct_2.text: *I bend down, pretending to pick up a pen. Fumbling under the desk. Slowly, on purpose. — Not looking at her. The moment I look, the lie cracks.*

after3_seo_correct_3.name: {name}
after3_seo_correct_3.text: Oh, here it is. — Pens really go missing a lot in the council room, huh?

after3_seo_correct_4.name: {name}
after3_seo_correct_4.text: *I look up. Seoyeon is wiping the smudged makeup away with the back of her hand, leaving a black streak on her skin.*

after3_seo_correct_5.name: Seoyeon
after3_seo_correct_5.text: ...The disappearing pens are an actual mystery. Thirty a year.

after3_seo_correct_6.name: {name}
after3_seo_correct_6.text: The president can't even catch the culprit?

after3_seo_correct_7.name: Seoyeon
after3_seo_correct_7.text: *A small laugh.* If I caught them — students would start fearing the council.

after3_seo_correct_8.name: {name}
after3_seo_correct_8.text: *The conversation keeps going naturally. Seoyeon fixes her glasses again, and I keep pretending to look under the desk.*

after3_seo_correct_11.name: Seoyeon
after3_seo_correct_11.text: About picking up the pen. — Come pick it up again sometime.

after3_seo_correct_12.name: {name}
after3_seo_correct_12.text: *Seoyeon folds next week's student council schedule and slides it toward me.*

after3_seo_freetalk.name: Seoyeon
after3_seo_freetalk.text: *She holds the clipboard to her chest and looks at {name}.* If you have something to say, say it now.
after3_seo_freetalk.context: Day 3 after school, just after a difficult conversation with Seoyeon. Suspicion that the protagonist gave their heart to two people has fractured the relationship, leaving Seoyeon hurt and with facts she still wants clarified.
after3_seo_freetalk.personality: Seoyeon is a composed and direct student council president. Even when jealous or hurt, she prefers to establish what happened and state her boundaries rather than settle for assumptions.

after3_seo_end.name: {name}
after3_seo_end.text: *After that one sentence, Seoyeon pulls the clipboard deeper into her arms.*

after3_reject_for_yuna_1.name: {name}
after3_reject_for_yuna_1.text: *Seoyeon is organizing her clipboard in the hallway. Her hands turn the pages faster than usual.*

after3_reject_for_yuna_2.name: Seoyeon
after3_reject_for_yuna_2.text: Busy with council work. I'll eat on my own. ...Just for today.

after3_reject_for_yuna_walk_gym.name: {name}
after3_reject_for_yuna_walk_gym.text: *My feet carry me toward the gym.*

after3_reject_for_yuna_3.name: Dain
after3_reject_for_yuna_3.text: *She is hitting balls alone in the gym.*

after3_reject_for_yuna_3_react.name: {name}
after3_reject_for_yuna_3_react.text: *But she turns her face away, tightening her grip on her book.*

after3_reject_for_yuna_4.name: {name}
after3_reject_for_yuna_4.text: *I leave the gym and return to the hall. Seoyeon's message remains marked as read, and Dain still hasn't replied.*

after3_yuna_1.name: {name}
after3_yuna_1.text: *The library annex. Yuna’s secret reading nook. — The door is open.*

after3_yuna_2.name: {name}
after3_yuna_2.text: *Yuna isn't there. Instead, an open notebook lies on the sofa, its pages filled with handwriting. Yuna's name is written in small letters inside the cover.*

after3_yuna_4.name: {name}
after3_yuna_4.text: *First page. 'One day a transfer student came. He found the library and sat next to me without saying a word. — I didn't mind it.'*

after3_yuna_7.name: {name}
after3_yuna_7.text: *Yuna’s voice from behind. I turn around and she’s standing there holding two drinks. — She freezes when she sees me looking at the notebook.*

after3_yuna_8b.name: Yuna
after3_yuna_8b.text: *She rushes over and snatches the notebook away.* ...I didn't say you could read it.

after3_yuna_9.name: Yuna
after3_yuna_9.text: *She hides the side of her face behind the notebook. Only the exposed tip of her ear is red.*

after3_yuna_choice.name: {name}
choices: This is about me, isn't it? 'A transfer student who sat down without a word' — that's me.
This author's really good. Got a sequel? I'd love to borrow it.

after3_yuna_decode_trap_1.name: Yuna
after3_yuna_decode_trap_1.text: *She clutches the notebook tighter. Her knuckles go white.*

after3_yuna_decode_trap_3.name: {name}
after3_yuna_decode_trap_3.text: Not? But look at this part — 'reading by the classroom window—'

after3_yuna_decode_trap_5.name: Yuna
after3_yuna_decode_trap_5.text: *She shoves the notebook into her bag, moving much faster than usual.*

after3_yuna_decode_trap_6.name: Yuna
after3_yuna_decode_trap_6.text: ...Because of people like you. I can't write a single line.

after3_yuna_decode_trap_8.name: Yuna
after3_yuna_decode_trap_8.text: If I get caught even inside fiction — there's nowhere left to escape.

after3_yuna_decode_trap_9.name: Yuna
after3_yuna_decode_trap_9.text: *She shoulders her bag and heads for the ladder. Her foot pauses once, then continues down.*

after3_yuna_decode_trap_10.name: Yuna
after3_yuna_decode_trap_10.text: ...This place. I'm locking it from now on.

after3_yuna_decode_trap_11.name: {name}
after3_yuna_decode_trap_11.text: *Footsteps descending the ladder. I'm left alone in the loft. Only finger marks remain where the notebook was. My eyes catch the last sentence on the open page. 'No one was allowed in here.'*

after3_yuna_correct_1.name: Yuna
after3_yuna_correct_1.text: *Her grip on the notebook loosens — just slightly. For maybe one second.*

after3_yuna_correct_3.name: {name}
after3_yuna_correct_3.text: Yeah. Whose is this? Was it published?

after3_yuna_correct_5.name: {name}
after3_yuna_correct_5.text: Shame. Something this good shouldn't stay buried.

after3_yuna_correct_6.name: Yuna
after3_yuna_correct_6.text: *She puts the notebook back on the desk. The arms that had hugged it to her chest slowly relax.*

after3_yuna_correct_9.name: Yuna
after3_yuna_correct_9.text: ...Let's just say the author allows it.

after3_yuna_correct_10.name: Yuna
after3_yuna_correct_10.text: *She holds out the notebook with both hands. Her elbows are a little stiffer than when she lends me a book.*

after3_yuna_correct_11.name: {name}
after3_yuna_correct_11.text: *The paper lands in my palm. Yuna doesn’t take her eyes off the cover of the notebook.*

after3_yuna_correct_12.name: Yuna
after3_yuna_correct_12.text: When you're done — write one line for the author. Anonymously.

after3_yuna_freetalk.name: Yuna
after3_yuna_freetalk.text: *She folds and unfolds the bookmark, walking half a step behind.* ...There is something I want to check.
after3_yuna_freetalk.context: Day 3 after school, just after a conversation with Yuna. She is keeping the conversation going because she wants to understand what actually happened between the people involved.
after3_yuna_freetalk.personality: Yuna is a calm and observant reader. Rather than assume jealousy or hide behind an obscure metaphor, she asks directly when there is something she needs to know.

after3_yuna_end.name: Yuna
after3_yuna_end.text: *She clutches the notebook tightly to her chest.*

after3_reject_for_dain_1.name: Seoyeon
after3_reject_for_dain_1.text: *She's smiling as she lines up the corners of the pages on her clipboard.*

after3_reject_for_dain_2.name: Seoyeon
after3_reject_for_dain_2.text: ...Got things to do today. I'll head out first.

after3_reject_for_dain_3.name: {name}
after3_reject_for_dain_3.text: *There is no note in the library. Yuna's bag is gone too. Only a faint ring of condensation remains on the desk, like she was here just moments ago.*

after3_reject_for_dain_3b.name: {name}
after3_reject_for_dain_3b.text: *I return to the hall. A trail of water from Yuna's cup remains on the floor.*

after3_dain_1.name: {name}
after3_dain_1.text: *In the gym, Dain stretches alone. She tries a light hop, twists her right leg, and winces.*

after3_dain_4.name: Dain
after3_dain_4.text: I'm fine! I just twisted it a little.

after3_dain_6.name: Dain
after3_dain_6.text: *Only after she finishes speaking does Dain laugh loudly.*

after3_dain_choice.name: Dain
after3_dain_choice.text: *She sits on the bench. The hand rubbing her knee keeps circling the same spot.*
choices: ...Are you okay? Don't push yourself. Maybe rest for today.
Then I'll stay here. Talk when you're ready.

after3_dain_pity_trap_1.name: Dain
after3_dain_pity_trap_1.text: *Her hand stops rubbing her knee. Slowly, she lifts her head.*

after3_dain_pity_trap_3.name: Dain
after3_dain_pity_trap_3.text: Hey. I'm not pushing it. I just — landed wrong.

after3_dain_pity_trap_4.name: {name}
after3_dain_pity_trap_4.text: *Dain stands. Her knee trembles slightly as she picks up her bag.*

after3_dain_pity_trap_5.name: Dain
after3_dain_pity_trap_5.text: ...Don't look at me like that. Not you too.

after3_dain_pity_trap_7.name: Dain
after3_dain_pity_trap_7.text: With that look they give me in the nurse's office.

after3_dain_pity_trap_8.name: Dain
after3_dain_pity_trap_8.text: *She walks toward the gym door. She doesn't run like usual. The drag of her sneakers leaves a long echo.*

after3_dain_pity_trap_9.name: Dain
after3_dain_pity_trap_9.text: Coach does it. My parents do it. Everyone does it. — I thought you wouldn't.

after3_dain_pity_trap_10.name: {name}
after3_dain_pity_trap_10.text: *The gym door closes. Not a slam. Quietly. One of Dain's wrist guards lies on the floor.*

after3_dain_correct_1.name: Dain
after3_dain_correct_1.text: *She stops. The hand that had been covering her knee hangs in the air.*

after3_dain_correct_5.name: {name}
after3_dain_correct_5.text: Is that good weird or bad weird.

after3_dain_correct_6.name: Dain
after3_dain_correct_6.text: ...I don't know. But stay here for a minute. I don't really want to be alone right now.

after3_dain_correct_7.name: Dain
after3_dain_correct_7.text: *She makes room on the inside of the bench. With her toe, she rolls the volleyball out of the court.*

after3_dain_correct_9.name: {name}
after3_dain_correct_9.text: *I sit beside her. The ball stops at the boundary line. For a while, Dain only reties her shoelaces.*

after3_dain_correct_10.name: Dain
after3_dain_correct_10.text: I don't usually talk about things like this. ...Where do I even start?

after3_dain_correct_11.name: Dain
after3_dain_correct_11.text: *She starts to straighten her right leg, stops, then bends it again. Her hand remains on her knee.*

after3_dain_dilemma_tell_2.name: {name}
after3_dain_dilemma_tell_2.text: Your knee. You've been rubbing it this whole time. This isn't from twisting it today, is it?

after3_dain_dilemma_tell_3.name: {name}
after3_dain_dilemma_tell_3.text: *Dain presses her lips together. Her voice, loud only a moment ago, cuts off.*

after3_dain_dilemma_tell_4.name: Dain
after3_dain_dilemma_tell_4.text: ...Why bring it up if you knew. You know the tournament is next week.

after3_dain_dilemma_tell_5.name: {name}
after3_dain_dilemma_tell_5.text: Your knee matters more than the tournament.

after3_dain_dilemma_tell_6.name: Dain
after3_dain_dilemma_tell_6.text: That's not your call to make.

after3_dain_dilemma_tell_7.name: Dain
after3_dain_dilemma_tell_7.text: *She stands up. Her knee creaks. Her hand stops halfway to her shoelaces.*

after3_dain_dilemma_final.name: Dain
after3_dain_dilemma_final.text: *Her eyes are wet. Nothing follows the end of her sentence.*

after3_dain_tell_confirm_2.name: Dain
after3_dain_tell_confirm_2.text: *She grabs her bag and walks out. She doesn't look back. The gym door slams shut.*

after3_dain_tell_confirm_3.name: {name}
after3_dain_tell_confirm_3.text: *I'm standing in the empty gym. Beyond the closed door, Dain's footsteps fade. There's sweat left on my palms.*

after3_dain_tell_retreat.name: Dain
after3_dain_tell_retreat.text: *She lets out a relieved breath. Only the sound of a ball rolling across the gym floor remains.*

after3_dain_choice1.name: {name}
after3_dain_choice1.text: *I sit beside her without a word. Dain glances my way.*

after3_dain_choice1_3.name: {name}
after3_dain_choice1_3.text: Because you'd just say you're fine.

after3_dain_choice1_react.name: Dain
after3_dain_choice1_react.text: *She stops, then smiles a little. She rubs the corner of her eye once with the back of her hand.*

after3_dain_freetalk.name: Dain
after3_dain_freetalk.text: *She adjusts her wrist guard and forces a smile.* Today, I'll talk first.
after3_dain_freetalk.context: Day 3 after school, just after a conversation with Dain. She is trying to meet the protagonist with her usual brightness, but hurt and uncertainty remain, and she wants to understand which relationships the protagonist has chosen.
after3_dain_freetalk.personality: Dain is an energetic and straightforward volleyball player. Humor and sincerity can both appear naturally as she expresses what she feels and what she wants to know about the relationship.

after3_dain_end.name: Dain
after3_dain_end.text: *She lightly punches my shoulder with her fist. — Weaker than yesterday.*

after3_dain_end_first.name: Dain
after3_dain_end_first.text: *She lightly punches my shoulder. — She seems embarrassed.*

after3_confront_1.name: {name}
after3_confront_1.text: *As I leave, I find Seoyeon waiting in the hall with her arms crossed. Her usual composure is gone.*

after3_confront_3.name: Seoyeon
after3_confront_3.text: *She leads me to the deserted end of the hall.*

after3_confront_5.name: Seoyeon
after3_confront_5.text: When you smiled at the other girls the same way, I felt like I'd been the only one reading into it.

after3_confront_5_b.name: Dain
after3_confront_5_b.text: *With her head lowered.* ...I didn't like it either.

after3_confront_5_c.name: Dain
after3_confront_5_c.text: *Her head drops. The toe of one sneaker scrapes briefly against the hallway floor.*

after3_confront_6.name: Seoyeon
after3_confront_6.text: That mess at lunch... What were you even thinking, making plans with all three of us?

after3_confront_choice.name: Seoyeon
after3_confront_choice.text: *She lowers the clipboard and waits for an answer without looking away.*
choices: The time slots are different, so I thought it would be fine
You’re the only one I’m serious about

after3_confront_admit_2.name: Seoyeon
after3_confront_admit_2.text: You apologized at lunch. But you still haven't said who you're sorry to, or what you're sorry for.

after3_confront_admit_3.name: Seoyeon
after3_confront_admit_3.text: *She picks up her lunch bag. Her hands are trembling.*

after3_confront_admit_4.name: Seoyeon
after3_confront_admit_4.text: You didn't want to hear us say no, so you left the decision to us. That isn't honesty.

after3_confront_admit_5.name: Seoyeon
after3_confront_admit_5.text: ...I won’t be leaving the rooftop open today.

after3_confront_admit_6.name: {name}
after3_confront_admit_6.text: *Her back is straight. Her fists are clenched. Her knuckles are white.*

after3_confront_excuse.name: Seoyeon
after3_confront_excuse.text: ...You don’t see how that’s the problem?

after3_confront_excuse_b.name: Seoyeon
after3_confront_excuse_b.text: *Her eyes are cold. The makeup stain on the back of her hand still hasn't come off.*

after3_confront_excuse_2.name: Seoyeon
after3_confront_excuse_2.text: It's not about how many people you made plans with. It's about what that promise meant to me.

after3_confront_lie_2.name: Seoyeon
after3_confront_lie_2.text: *She turns around. The eyes that wanted to believe are the first to turn away.*

after3_confront_lie_2_b.name: {name}
after3_confront_lie_2_b.text: *Her back is straight. Her fists are clenched. Her knuckles are white.*

after3_confront_end.name: Seoyeon
after3_confront_end.text: *I stand alone in the empty hall. The image of her straight back and white-knuckled fists lingers.*

after3_final.name: {name}
after3_final.text: *The afternoon ends. One by one, the hallway lights switch off.*

minsu_d3_1.name: {name}
minsu_d3_1.text: *Walking home. Minsu is standing by the school gate.*

minsu_d3_3.name: Minsu
minsu_d3_3.text: At lunch. And Seoyeon's face just now.

minsu_d3_4.name: Minsu
minsu_d3_4.text: What did I say yesterday? If all three of them end up crying, that's on you. Looks like that 'later' came faster than expected.

minsu_d3_5.name: Minsu
minsu_d3_5.text: It's rough watching from the side. They're all good people. I don't think you're doing this on purpose, but you keep putting off saying no.

minsu_d3_5b.name: Minsu
minsu_d3_5b.text: *He sighs and sets the straw wrapper he was folding on the table.*

minsu_d3_6b.name: Minsu
minsu_d3_6b.text: I won't ask what happened at your old school. But I'll say one thing.

minsu_d3_7.name: Minsu
minsu_d3_7.text: Saying no is consideration too. If it isn't going to work, drawing the line now is better than leaving room for hope.

minsu_d3_8.name: {name}
minsu_d3_8.text: *Saying no is consideration. At my old school, I gave Sojeong neither a chance to hear a confession nor a chance to reject it. Because I couldn't say anything.*

minsu_d3_9.name: Minsu
minsu_d3_9.text: *He didn't say more. The straw wrapper on the table is folded all the way to the end.*

minsu_d3_10.name: Minsu
minsu_d3_10.text: See you at school tomorrow. — Think about it seriously.

haeun_warn_1.name: {name}
haeun_warn_1.text: *I step out of the student council room. The hall is empty. — Someone is waiting.*

haeun_warn_1_b.name: Haeun
haeun_warn_1_b.text: *She is leaning against the wall. She's fiddling with her student council bracelet.*

haeun_warn_2_b.name: {name}
haeun_warn_2_b.text: Haeun? What are you doing here?

haeun_warn_4.name: Haeun
haeun_warn_4.text: I saw her for a moment in the bathroom behind the student council room. She told me she was fine, but... she didn't look fine.

haeun_warn_5.name: {name}
haeun_warn_5.text: *Haeun checks the empty hall, then lowers her voice further.*

haeun_warn_5b.name: Haeun
haeun_warn_5b.text: She told me not to talk to her, but she stayed at the sink for a long time.

haeun_warn_5c_b.name: Seoyeon
haeun_warn_5c_b.text: Watching you smile the same way at other people — I kind of hated it.

haeun_warn_6.name: Haeun
haeun_warn_6.text: If I follow her, she'll just tell me she's fine again. She might listen to you, {name}.

haeun_warn_7.name: Haeun
haeun_warn_7.text: I know I'm meddling. But just for today, please don't pretend you didn't notice.

haeun_warn_7_b.name: Haeun
haeun_warn_7_b.text: *She stops, her gaze flicking briefly toward the faculty office.*

haeun_warn_7_c.name: Haeun
haeun_warn_7_c.text: I'm not asking you to persuade her. Just don't leave her alone.

haeun_warn_7_d.name: Haeun
haeun_warn_7_d.text: *She turns and leaves. Seoyeon's empty student council armband hangs at the end of the hallway.*

haeun_warn_8.name: {name}
haeun_warn_8.text: *After Haeun leaves, I knock on the student council room door. No one answers, but a chair scrapes inside.*

haeun_warn_8b.name: {name}
haeun_warn_8b.text: *I walk out to the front of the school.*
